text_block_list.text:
—Year's end has arrived.
Up until today, Narita Top Road has—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh--!!

Building and building, stacking it all up.
Training, racing experience, and then...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Good... work... out there... aaah...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Without even realizing it...

She's built up her ability... but taken quite a beating in the process.
I tried coaching her to take better care of her body, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Bleeding again...
But this is nothing...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah, yes...
choice_data_list: Let's try not to push ourselves too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Yes, understood!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh... But running without giving it your all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san...
I just don't know what mindset
I should have going into this...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then I'll just go with the momentum!
—Hah!

Her clumsiness backfired. The moment I told her not to push herself,
she became completely helpless...

In the end, I kept pushing myself piece by piece.
The scratches and fatigue only continued to pile up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm sorry...
I really want to do better, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"With my current ability, I can't reach the summit...
Whenever I start feeling that way, I just can't help it..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was an emotion or an impulse...
I just couldn't stop that kind of feeling...

Narita Top Road's passion is righteous.
And because it was righteous, it was all the more troublesome.

It is difficult to stop the desire to reach for brilliance.
The least we can do is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Complete rest... is it? Understood...
Ah, come to think of it, tomorrow is...
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's watch Admire Vega's race.
Yeah, let's go watch Admire Vega's race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Indeed. The day Ayabe-san enters a graded race...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Even without training, it seems like there's a lot to learn!
The presence of Admire Vega, the Umamusume everyone looked up to, grew greater day by day within the Twinkle Series.

Yes, after the race where
Admire Vega suffered a disqualification—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega holds firm this time!
A magnificent revenge!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The opponents were clearly out of her league.
Repelling their fierce pursuit, she claimed a hard-fought victory!"
—True to her word. Admire Vega turned her humiliation into strength and claimed victory, just as she had vowed.

And tomorrow... is the day of the graded stakes race.
For her, it was the big moment.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, they're coming out, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-saaan, do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Their cheering squad is
putting up quite a fight, too.
Still, we won't let ourselves be outdone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Right! Two of my friends are running!
Go get 'em, sparkling clear skies, aim for an upset!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The atmosphere is awfully noisy.
So this is... a graded race...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"None of that matters, though.
I'll just keep moving forward... toward the place I'm striving for."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"What I'm aiming for...
isn't just the pinnacle of the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Above that lies... the night sky.
To reach it—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Heh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Right at the start, Admire Vega smoothly drops back! As usual, she positions herself slightly behind mid-pack.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She shows no sign of panic whatsoever.
As smoothly as flowing water,
she presses on steadily!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san...
She's always so calm, but...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer, today...
choice_data_list: Yeah, it feels even sharper now.
Yeah, your senses are even sharper now.

text_block_list.text:
She wastes no movement whatsoever.
It's as if she's blending seamlessly into the silence of the night.
And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Admire Vega moves up smoothly! Third, second, and now she takes the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Not a single sign of tension!
Accelerating naturally, she crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega! It's Admire Vega!
An undisputed first-magnitude star has just lit up the western sky!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: She will undoubtedly be one of the leading figures in next year's Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
So this is... the current Ayabe-san...
I have to surpass this running...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't reach the summit. Nor could I...
live up to the expectations of everyone supporting me...

"Damn it," I thought. A rival's strong performance
only gives you more reason to push yourself harder.

I intended to let her rest, but at this rate,
it seems it will only end up exhausting Narita Top Road further.
And so—the next day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaahhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... To think this is the best
run I can manage...!
choice_data_list: Want to go for just one more?
Want to go for just one more?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: We'll wrap things up here for today.

Narita Top Road's demeanor changed slightly.
Her burning passion remained the same. But...

The color deep within her eyes is different.
This light is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I finally realized. She isn't an opponent
I can catch up to through reckless determination alone...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san is at a much higher level than I thought.
It will take a long time to catch up. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I hear the only way up this mountain path
is to climb it steadily, bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
If I don't, my dream won't come true,
and I'll even disappoint everyone who's cheering for me...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Ayabe-san, the one I look up to.
That's precisely why...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Without running out of steam,
I want to keep up... No matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
After watching yesterday's race,
my feelings completely flipped around...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised myself.
It's like my impatience suddenly vanished...

What changed Narita Top Road was likely
...an Umamusume's instinct to become stronger.

Her rival's overwhelming strength ironically showed her
that she would never reach that brilliance if she stayed as she was.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Our next race... is it?
The race I have in mind is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "The Yayoi Sho. From there, I plan to head straight toward the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (I see... Ayabe-san is aiming for the Yayoi Sho next March...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I've never run it in an actual race before.
It might still be too soon...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: (Still, if I could just feel that running up close...!)

A straightforward personality. Which is precisely why
her feelings were written so clearly on her face.
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?
choice_data_list: To Admire Vega in the Yayoi Sho...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
“—Are you here?
You're finally here, aren't you...!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. There are surely many things we'll never understand
unless we truly run together with all our might.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to know! In the Yayoi Sho,
just how truly amazing you are, Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: —Yes!
A year spent constantly chasing that shining star comes to an end. And then—

Next year is finally the year of our clash.
Admire Vega will be waiting at the Yayoi Sho.
